name: Okuchi Kara Hajimaru Shanai Furin ~Onna Joushi ni Shiborarete~
original_name: お口から始まる社内不倫 ～女上司に絞られて～
source:
Touji Ema is a slacker office worker. The one person he really struggles with is his strict and flawless female boss, Shiori Nagoe.

But one day, Touji discovers a side of Shiori that she had never shown anyone before.
What she had been struggling with was a problem in her sex life with her husband.
After they shared that secret, their relationship began to change little by little.

Time spent together while harboring secrets.
And where will their journey lead them—?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01006877.html/]dlsite[/url]]
